hypotheses.statement: The end of the east full_service merchant incentive (activity-east-full-service-summer, ending 2026-08-30) is the best-supported explanation for the simultaneous drop in enrollments and redemptions observed on 08-31/09-01, conditional on the incentive having driven traffic and redemption during its active window.

The redemption_rate drop (0.70 to 0.45) is consistent with removal of a redemption-driving incentive, but no direct record documents how the incentive acted on each stage.
